topics.title: France rethinks teen social media ban
topics.summary: France's constitutional court blocked a proposed under-15 social media ban, saying the law needed clearer safeguards around speech, privacy and age checks.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the group had to set phone rules for teens, who would want a hard cutoff and who would argue for trust plus better tools?

topics.title: Hawaii prepares for Tropical Storm Lala
topics.summary: Hawaii officials are urging residents to prepare as Tropical Storm Lala approaches, with warnings for heavy rain, strong winds and possible flooding on the Big Island.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who in the room becomes the practical emergency-kit person, and who mostly copes by nervously tracking every weather map update?

topics.title: Belgian sewer dig uncovers gold
topics.summary: A Belgian student working on sewer trenches helped uncover gold coins and bars worth millions, hidden in a wall under a former brewery owner's villa.
topics.discussionPrompt: If someone found treasure during a boring summer job, who would immediately call the authorities and who would start imagining a reward speech?

topics.title: Stolen modern paintings recovered
topics.summary: Italian police recovered paintings attributed to Cezanne, Renoir and Matisse after a years-long investigation into works stolen from a private collection.
topics.discussionPrompt: Which character would treat recovered art like a grand mystery, and who would mostly wonder how anyone hides famous paintings for that long?
